title: Page 47
transc:
"9"  4 P. M.
Horner N. Y.  Washn D. C Apl. 20. 1864
for Vienna Van Vliet period Capt
Wise had chartered to evening of
19th inst. eight tugs Washn needs 
six & Ft Monroe two Period Consult
him & dispatch them from whatever
port can most quickly deliver them 
comma Ft Monroe to be first supplied
period Time presses sig abbot Henrietta 


(No 9)
Horner NY  Wash. Apl. 20. 1864
for Van Vliet Your dispatch says
vessels are to sail this week
This is too slow all should
be at hammer by twenty fourth
at farthest Period Let steamers tow
them period I dispatched you fully
on this subject & also instructed
Capt Wise by superb Aragon reliance


Geo D. Sheldon. Ft Monroe  Washn Apl 20th 1864
Rosetta For Knox Unity Receive all the
sick and wounded the Confederate authorities will
send you but send no more in
Exchange yoke Juno hope this is last
